notes.title: Kejora will now release on 8th January 2026!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="638tsmf1Jd4;full"][/previewyoutube]
After working on the game for the past 4 years, we were excited to finally release our project into the world on 4th September 2025. However, after the announcement that Hollow Knight: Silksong was to release on the same day, we made the tough decision to shift our release away from September. 

We want the best for our project, for it to be seen and supported, and this can not be done if it releases on the same day as Silksong; with no disrespect. We, as well, have been eagerly anticipating this title, and it was just unfortunate it was set to release on the same day we chose months ago. 

While Kejora was set for a Steam-only release on 4th September, we are now looking forward to bringing Kejora to you on 8th January 2026, together with the Epic Games Store, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4/5, and Xbox Series X|S platforms! 

Thank you to everyone who has supported and played Kejora so far! We apologize for the delay, but we hope you'll stick around for the game in 2026!

notes.title: Kejora has a release date!
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce that we have finally confirmed a release date for Kejora! Kejora will be available on Steam on 4th September 2025 

It's been a long journey, but we're happy to finally be in the last legs of development and production, and we couldn't have done it without the support and love from the community!

Thank you all, and we'll see you on 4th September!
